On November 8, 2022, police were advised of a theft from a motor vehicle incident in Wausau, WI. The 911 caller had tracked the location of his backpack to a residence via Apple Airtag after it was stolen from his vehicle. While police consulted with the resident of the home, their sister pulled up, questioning the officers’ actions and mayhem emerged. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved.
